title: The published median rose from RM166 in 1970 to RM7,017 in 2024; in constant 2010 RM the endpoints are RM706 and RM5,284.
subtitle: National median gross monthly household income; current-year RM and constant 2010 RM; available observations 1970–2024
notes: 1970 and 1974 cover Peninsular Malaysia only; citizens-only coverage starts in 1989.
2020 is an estimate based on the 2019 survey, not a fresh survey observation.
Use official annual overall CPI from 1960; no extrapolated CPI or invented income years.
For predict-then-reveal: use year on the x-axis, hide later actuals in the interface and reveal on request; no forecast is produced.
headline: The published median rose from RM166 in 1970 to RM7,017 in 2024; in constant 2010 RM the endpoints are RM706 and RM5,284. Coverage changes mean this is a descriptive historical series, not a like-for-like growth estimate.
